title: The Stag Trial
text: A stag steps out of the mist, white as bone, its antlers like a winter tree and its eyes burning. It offers a race to whoever thinks they can win. It does not say what happens to the loser.

options.label: The fastest races the white stag without asking what losing costs.

outcomes.text: They run neck and neck until the stag bows. Something of its speed stays with them.
The stag wins, leaving them bleeding from the legs in a thicket.

options.label: Bow to the stag and decline its race.

outcomes.text: It leads you a stretch through the mist.

options.label: The Leader shoots it; a white hide is worth a purse.

outcomes.text: The forest goes very quiet, and stays that way.
